affiliation: Open Frontier Lab · Virtual research organization
heroTitle: Research in AI, power systems, and quantum computing.
heroDescription: Open Frontier Lab conducts research in artificial intelligence for power systems and applied quantum machine learning, supported by practical courses and guided research.
introduction: Open Frontier Lab brings together researchers and learners to study intelligent energy systems, quantum machine learning, and secure infrastructure through collaborative research, open resources, and hands-on training.

whatWeDo.label: What we do
whatWeDo.title: Research in intelligent energy and quantum learning
whatWeDo.description: Our virtual labs connect research, education, and mentorship across artificial intelligence, power systems, and quantum computing.

areas.title: AI in power systems
areas.description: Applying machine learning to electricity demand forecasting, renewable integration, and reliable power system operation.

areas.title: Applied quantum learning
areas.description: Evaluating quantum algorithms, feature maps, and hybrid learning methods through reproducible experiments.

areas.title: Secure intelligent systems
areas.description: Investigating anomaly detection and machine learning methods for connected energy infrastructure.

areas.title: Research education
areas.description: Supporting new researchers with practical courses, reading resources, mentorship, and guided internships.

collaboration.title: Research collaboration and lab enrollment
collaboration.description: Contact the lab to discuss research partnerships, student projects, guided internships, or participation in our virtual learning programs.
